items.headline: Georgia back at No. 1 in AP Top 25 ahead of Utah, Irish; Buckeyes drop to 21st
items.description: Georgia took No. 1 in the latest AP Top 25 rankings for the second time this season after Miami's loss to Notre Dame, while Ohio State has fallen from No. 2 two weeks ago to No. 21 after a home loss to Oregon.
